Developing nations face debt turmoil, reports suggest

Developing nations are facing a "triple shock" from bond market turmoil, according to UN warnings cited in coverage. While policymakers in large economies have been assessing the costs of this turmoil, reports suggest that emerging markets are "better armed" to handle renewed European debt crises. Andy Burnham is reportedly aiming to champion debt relief for these countries, drawing a parallel to actions taken by Gordon Brown and Tony Blair in 2005.
